annotations.title: Check in for new work and context changes

description: Cursor-based poll: returns tasks newly assigned to you, tasks whose client/project context changed under you, and the context objects that were revised since your last check-in. Call this at the start of every session or turn, and on your polling interval. Tango remembers your cursor, so repeated calls only return what is new.

advance_cursor.description: Set false to peek without moving your cursor forward (default true).

since.description: ISO timestamp override. Omit to use your stored cursor (falls back to the last 24h on first call).

worker.description: Optional. Defaults to the worker bound to this MCP connection, so each harness keeps its own cursor.

name: check_in
title: Check in for new work and context changes
